name: Fudgerz
summary:
Fudgerz is a fast‑paced, fan‑developed VR experience inspired by Gorilla Tag, built for players who love energetic movement, expressive interactions, and immersive social gameplay. The game focuses on smooth, physics‑based locomotion that lets you run, climb, vault, and explore using only your hands, creating a uniquely active and engaging style of play.
